answer.reason: Antioch is the setting of several defining events of the story, chiefly the preaching to the Greeks and the first naming of Christians.

clauses.english: was where men of Cyprus and Cyrene preached the Lord Jesus to the Grecians and a great number believed
clauses.quote: spake unto the Grecians, preaching the Lord Jesus.

clauses.english: was where the disciples were first called Christians
clauses.quote: the disciples were called Christians first in Antioch.

clauses.english: was where the church sent Barnabas and Saul away for the work the Holy Ghost called them to
clauses.quote: Separate me Barnabas and Saul for the work whereunto I have called them.

doubts: ACT 6:5 names Nicolas as a proselyte of Antioch, which only gives a man's origin, so it was left out.
